how_to_apply: Fill the bio-data in the prescribed proforma printed on page 3 of the notice.
Attach a self-attested photograph and self-attested copies of mark sheets, proof of date of birth, qualification, experience and caste certificates.
Report at Indian Institute of Soil Science, Nabibagh, Berasia Road, Bhopal on 27-11-2026, 30 minutes before the 10:00 A.M. schedule.
Bring original documents for verification and submit the bio-data set in the office at the time of interview.
important_instructions: Be present 30 minutes before the scheduled time for necessary formalities Decision of the Director, IISS, Bhopal is final and binding in all aspects

rows.icar_indian_institute_of_soil_science_ii: ICAR-Indian Institute of Soil Science, Bhopal

M.Sc. in Soil Science/Agril. Chemistry/Soil Chemistry and Fertility/Agronomy. Candidates with a post graduate degree in Basic Sciences (3 years Bachelor's degree and 2 years Master degree) must have N.E.T./GATE qualification.
Indian Institute of Soil Science, Nabibagh, Berasia Road, Bhopal

content_sections.heading: IISS Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. 12-317/2025-Estt. gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download IISS notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: M.Sc. in Soil Science/Agril. Chemistry/Soil Chemistry and Fertility/Agronomy; Candidates having post graduate degree in Basic Sciences with 3 years Bachelor's degree and 2 years Master degree must have N.E.T./GATE qualification Experience: Desirable: experience on conducting field experiments; experience on soil and plant sample analysis; knowledge on basic soil microbial analysis Age limit: 21 to 35 years Age relaxation: Women/SC/ST/OBC/PH As per ICAR / Government norms Other conditions: Positions are purely on temporary basis No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview Canvassing in any form will lead to cancellation of candidature Desirable: Experience on conducting field experiments Experience on soil and plant sample analysis Knowledge on basic soil microbial analysis

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Purely temporary; co-terminus with the termination of the project Engagement initially for six months/one year or till termination of the project Extension subject to satisfactory performance of the work No right for absorption/regularization in the Institute, IISS or any sister concern including ICAR Headquarter Services can be dispensed with before project termination without notice Other terms as per guidelines for Junior Research Fellow working in the ICAR Schemes

content_sections.heading: How Will IISS Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Written Test Interview Written test and interview on 27-11-2026 Director, IISS, Bhopal reserves the right to fix criteria and short list candidates for screening of applications/for conducting written test

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Original documents for verification One set of complete bio-data in the prescribed format Self-attested photograph Self-attested mark sheets Self-attested proof of date of birth Self-attested certificates for qualification, experience and caste certificate

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IISS Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill the bio-data in the prescribed proforma printed on page 3 of the notice. Attach a self-attested photograph and self-attested copies of mark sheets, proof of date of birth, qualification, experience and caste certificates. Report at Indian Institute of Soil Science, Nabibagh, Berasia Road, Bhopal on 27-11-2026, 30 minutes before the 10:00 A.M. schedule. Bring original documents for verification and submit the bio-data set in the office at the time of interview.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Be present 30 minutes before the scheduled time for necessary formalities Decision of the Director, IISS, Bhopal is final and binding in all aspects

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for IISS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 27 November 2026, and candidates report at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in IISS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Junior Research Fellow.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for IISS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 27 November 2026 at 10:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Soil Science, Nabibagh, Berasia Road, Bhopal.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 21 to 35 years. Relaxation: Women/SC/ST/OBC/PH As per ICAR / Government norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 37000 per month + HRA.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: M.Sc. in Soil Science/Agril. Chemistry/Soil Chemistry and Fertility/Agronomy. Candidates with a post graduate degree in Basic Sciences (3 years Bachelor's degree and 2 years Master degree) must have N.E.T./GATE qualification.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Positions are purely on temporary basis. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Canvassing in any form will lead to cancellation of candidature.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Written Test. Interview. Written test and interview on 27-11-2026. Director, IISS, Bhopal reserves the right to fix criteria and short list candidates for screening of applications/for conducting written test.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely temporary; co-terminus with the termination of the project. Engagement initially for six months/one year or till termination of the project. Extension subject to satisfactory performance of the work.
